A fitted multi-limb rating curve (S7)

Source: R/flode_classes.R
FlodeRating.Rd

The result of rate_optimise() (or rate_optimise_constrained()): one row per limb in @limbs (bounds, coefficients C/a/n, fit diagnostics, and – when produced by rate_optimise_constrained() – alignment provenance), the raw gaugings in @gaugings, and bootstrap draws in @bootstrap when rate_optimise(..., n_boot = ) was used.

Usage

FlodeRating(
  gaugings = FlodeEvidence(),
  fit_starts = NULL,
  fit_origin = "independently_fitted",
  lifecycle = "draft",
  schema_version = 2L,
  provenance = list(),
  previous = NULL,
  limbs = data.table(),
  bootstrap = NULL
)

Arguments

gaugings

A FlodeEvidence table of the observations the fit was built from. A plain data.table with discharge_cms and stage_m columns is accepted and converted by as_flode_evidence(), which generates evidence IDs and records what it assumed. A gauging_datetime column (Date or POSIXct) becomes observation_time and is used for age weighting.

fit_starts

Data.table of multi-start fitting attempts, or NULL if the fit wasn't produced with multi_start = TRUE.

fit_origin

Character. How the fit came to be: one of "independently_fitted", "post_fit_aligned" or "constrained_refit". Read-only @status returns the same value.

lifecycle

Character. Where the rating stands in review: "draft" (default), "under_review", "approved", "superseded" or "withdrawn". The package never sets "approved"; that is a decision for a person.

schema_version

Integer. The layout version the object was made under; see rating_schema_version(). Leave at the default.

provenance

List recording how the fit was made (fitting method, controls, bounds, tool version).

previous

The exact pre-amendment FlodeRating this was built from (e.g. by align_limb_equations()/align_limb_boundaries()), or NULL (default) for an independently-fitted result.

limbs

Data.table, one row per limb: bounds, coefficients C/a/n, and fit diagnostics.

bootstrap

Data.table of per-draw bootstrap coefficients, or NULL if the fit wasn't produced with n_boot > 0.

Examples

# A FlodeRating normally comes from rate_optimise(); read it through
# the accessors.
set.seed(1)
stage_m <- seq(0.5, 3, by = 0.1)
discharge_cms <- 3.2 * stage_m^1.6 * exp(rnorm(length(stage_m), sd = 0.03))
fit <- rate_optimise(discharge_cms, stage_m)
fit
#> <FlodeRating> 1 limb(s), origin: independently_fitted, lifecycle: draft
#>     limb lower_stage_m upper_stage_m        C          a        n  rmse_cms
#>    <int>         <num>         <num>    <num>      <num>    <num>     <num>
#> 1:     1           0.5             3 3.520861 0.05580791 1.538393 0.2765406
#>    r_squared
#>        <num>
#> 1: 0.9973271
rating_limbs(fit)
#>     limb lower_stage_m upper_stage_m        C          a        n
#>    <int>         <num>         <num>    <num>      <num>    <num>
#> 1:     1           0.5             3 3.520861 0.05580791 1.538393
head(rating_evidence(fit))
#> <FlodeEvidence> 6 row(s), 6 included, source type(s): gauging
#> Note: Converted from a plain table; filled evidence_id, site_id, observation_time, source_type, source_name, source_version, quality_code, notes, exclusion_reason, included, weight, source_row, metadata. source_type assumed 'gauging', weight assumed 1, included TRUE unless stage or discharge is missing. 
#>    evidence_id stage_m discharge_cms observation_time source_type included
#>         <char>   <num>         <num>           <POSc>      <char>   <lgcl>
#> 1:        G001     0.5      1.035953             <NA>     gauging     TRUE
#> 2:        G002     0.6      1.420969             <NA>     gauging     TRUE
#> 3:        G003     0.7      1.763679             <NA>     gauging     TRUE
#> 4:        G004     0.8      2.348976             <NA>     gauging     TRUE
#> 5:        G005     0.9      2.730430             <NA>     gauging     TRUE
#> 6:        G006     1.0      3.122196             <NA>     gauging     TRUE

# The constructor checks its input, so a malformed object cannot exist:
# here the limb table is missing its stage bounds.
try(FlodeRating(
  limbs = data.table::data.table(limb = 1, C = 1, a = 0, n = 1),
  gaugings = data.table::data.table(discharge_cms = 1, stage_m = 1)
))
#> Warning: Tried to assign NULL to column 'metadata', but this column does not exist to remove
